deliverables.title: ZyBook Participation Activities
deliverables.notes: Weekly zyBooks participation activities (not challenge activities) must be completed by December 9 at 11:59 PM. Grades are automatically downloaded from zyBooks at the deadline. Partial completion earns partial credit. 5% mark deduction if registered with a non-Western email address or name mismatch.
